qs.q: Which population of cancer patients has an elevated incidence of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) caused by the JC virus?
o: Patients receiving therapy that eliminates B cells with rituximab
Patients undergoing maintenance transfusions of allogeneic granulocytes
Patients receiving routine seasonal vaccinations using inactivated viruses
Patients consuming strictly canned and thermally processed foods exclusively
qs.e: Patients receiving treatments that eliminate B cells, such as anti-CD20 antibodies like rituximab, are especially vulnerable to viral infections including progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy caused by the JC virus. Inactivated vaccines and dietary restrictions do not directly alter PML risk.
